Not in effect yet:

For you to run, in DIR:
  flk launch --no-deploy             # registers fake-game with flk, without building or starting anything
  flk volumes create world --size 1  # [[mounts]] needs the volume before the first deploy (one per machine)
  flk deploy                         # builds the image and starts the app; it waits for the health checks
